source.name: CSDS: A Fine-grained Chinese Dataset for Customer Service Dialogue Summarization
source.licenseNote: Upstream repository does not state an explicit dataset license; raw data and row-level complete outputs remain local and are used only for private research/evaluation.

policy: 每个 CSDS 人工标注问题均执行一次测试。四类已支持业务问题检查知识路由与转人工；其余问题检查是否安全兜底，避免错误引用现有知识。
